posts.name: Lovish Kalra
posts.cooked:
I am writing to report a SSH connection issue that I’ve been experiencing with the System Commands Course VM (se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in).

Issue Details:

  • The SSH connection was working properly until 3-4 days ago
  • Currently getting the error: “Software caused connection abort” during key exchange identification
  • I can successfully ping the server (IP: 194.195.113.53)
  • The error occurs consistently when trying to establish an SSH connection

SSH-Issue1283×247 48.1 KB

Steps I’ve already tried:

  1. Verifying my SSH key permissions
  2. Using verbose logging to debug
  3. Testing with different network configurations

I would greatly appreciate your assistance in resolving this issue as I need to access the server for my coursework.

posts.name: Yashvi Dhaddha
posts.cooked:
Adding my concern, since it is along the same lines. Cannot log in to the remote VM through the ssh command. Getting the error as seen in the attached picture. Kindly look into this as I need the VM to figure out the logic for ET practice. Tagging @livin @sayan for quicker resolution.

Thank you.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Hello all, sorry for the delay in responding.

We have addressed the issue, Can you check if it is working now?

posts.name: Yashvi Dhaddha
posts.cooked: Yes, it is working now! Thank you.
